presets.name: ROLLING BASS
presets.desc: The techno rolling bass: three sixteenths after every kick, a saw over a sine sub, the mixer pushing the ladder filter, the middle note pushed, an octave turning the bar.

presets.name: OFFBEAT BASS
presets.desc: The offbeat bass between the kicks: one round eighth on every and, a saw and a softer square over a sine sub, a fifth closing the second bar, F sharp minor to A.

presets.name: SUB PULSE
presets.desc: A deep pulse on the off sixteenths: a saw over a big sine sub in a soft 12 dB filter, the mixer pushed for body, nothing on the kick.

presets.name: MUNICH BASS
presets.desc: The 1977 disco bass for dark disco: root and octave bouncing in sixteenths, a saw and a square plucked by the ladder filter, the fifth and seventh closing the bar.

presets.name: GALLOP BASS
presets.desc: A galloping bass that answers the kick: root on the and, octave on the last sixteenth, a pulse wave breathing over two bars above a sine sub, its top a little apart.

presets.name: EBM BASS
presets.desc: Body music: straight eighths that never stop, a saw and a square through the Korg filter, short and hard, an octave jump closing the bar.

presets.name: TRIPLET ROLL
presets.desc: Sixteenth triplets rolling off every kick: an eighth on the and split in three, a hollow square over a sine sub in the ladder filter, the first of each three pushed.

presets.name: DUB BASS
presets.desc: Dub techno weight: a round saw over a deep sine sub on the offbeats, long swelling notes in a soft 12 dB filter moving over eight bars, the last one sliding down to the fifth.

presets.name: FIFTH BASS
presets.desc: A stab bass in fifths: two saws a fifth apart over a sine sub, short syncopated hits that leave the kick alone.

presets.name: KNOCK BASS
presets.desc: A minimal knock: a sine touched by FM and a triangle an octave above for the wooden attack, a sine sub, very short notes in a broken sixteenth pattern.

presets.name: OCTAVE DISCO
presets.desc: Disco octaves in eighths: a square and a saw bouncing root to octave, a short slide up now and then, over F sharp minor, A, D and E.

presets.name: PEAK ROLL
presets.desc: Peak time at 130: a growling saw with a second saw an octave above through the Korg filter, the mixer pushed hard, two hits after every kick and a doubled octave closing the bar.

presets.name: ACID LINE
presets.desc: A classic acid line: one saw in the ladder filter, warm resonance, accents that open it and slides that tie into the octave and back.

presets.name: SOFT ACID
presets.desc: Deep house acid: a soft wave between triangle and saw in the 12 dB filter, rounder resonance breathing over four bars, a sparse swung line sliding up to the octave.

presets.name: ACID ROLL
presets.desc: An acid top line at 130, an octave above the bass: a hollow pulse wave in the Korg filter, a three three two rhythm, slides into the octave, the two filters a little apart.

presets.name: ACID HYPNO
presets.desc: Three acid steps turning against the bar at 132, in the middle register: root, root, a slide to the octave, the cutoff rising and falling over eight bars.

presets.name: SQUARE ACID
presets.desc: A square wave acid bass, hollow and woody in the 12 dB filter, the two filters a little apart, a sparse syncopated line with two slides per bar.

presets.name: GHOST ACID
presets.desc: Minimal acid: a few saw notes left to chance, soft ghost notes between the accents, one ratchet, the resonance breathing slowly.

presets.name: SWING ACID
presets.desc: A swung acid top line an octave above the bass: a saw through the Korg filter, sixteenths pushed late, doubled hits, octave slides and a minor seventh answer, the two filters apart.

presets.name: DEEP ACID
presets.desc: Deep acid an octave down, in eighths: a saw and a square on the low F sharp, the resonance singing through the harmonics, long slides falling to the fifth below.

presets.name: HYPNO SEQ
presets.desc: Berlin school against the four on the floor: three notes and a breath, seven steps turning over sixteen, a saw over a square an octave below, the cutoff drifting over four bars.

presets.name: BLEEP SEQ
presets.desc: Bleep techno: clean sine and triangle tones, short and dry, a sparse two octave figure that leaves room for the drums.

presets.name: PLUCK SEQ
presets.desc: A swung techno pluck: two saws a few cents apart snapping shut in the 12 dB filter, chord tones on the offbeats.

presets.name: DISCO OCTAVES
presets.desc: Galloping disco octaves in the middle: a square and a saw jumping an octave, long first note and two short answers, over the Munich progression.

presets.name: ITALO ARP
presets.desc: An italo arpeggio climbing sevenths over two octaves in sixteenths, a pulse and a saw, through F sharp minor, D, A and E.

presets.name: DETROIT ARP
presets.desc: Warm Detroit chords broken into swung sixteenths: ninths up and down, a square and a triangle, the ladder filter half open.

presets.name: RATCHET SEQ
presets.desc: A sparse figure that stutters: a pulse wave plucked by the ladder filter, double, triple and quadruple hits inside single steps.

presets.name: POLYMETER SEQ
presets.desc: Five steps against sixteen, three notes and two rests: a saw and a hollow square, the pattern landing somewhere new on every bar, one note left to chance.

presets.name: DOTTED SEQ
presets.desc: Dotted eighths written into the notes, the echo without a delay: a saw and a triangle every three sixteenths, nine steps turning against the bar.

presets.name: SYNC SEQ
presets.desc: A hard sync lead that cuts without getting bright: the second saw locked to the first, its pitch swept over two bars, short syncopated notes.

presets.name: WOOD SEQ
presets.desc: Percussive wood for minimal grooves: a sine knocked by FM, very short, a broken figure with notes left to chance.

presets.name: DARK ARP
presets.desc: A dark three note arpeggio falling against the bar, a pulse wave in the Korg filter, its width jumping at random, F sharp minor to C sharp minor.

presets.name: DUB STAB
presets.desc: The dub techno stab: two saws a fifth apart, stacked and spread, a soft decaying chord on every offbeat, the second and fourth pushed.

presets.name: MINOR STAB
presets.desc: A minor Detroit stab: a saw on the root and a square on the minor tenth, snapping shut, syncopated sixteenths over F sharp minor, B minor and C sharp minor.

presets.name: SEVENTH STAB
presets.desc: A deep seventh, two long chords a bar: a soft wave and a saw a minor seventh apart in a round 12 dB filter, on the and of one and just after three, F sharp minor to B minor.

presets.name: ORGAN STAB
presets.desc: A nineties house organ: two squares an octave apart over a square sub, a fast organ envelope, a stab on the and of every beat with little pickups.

presets.name: GATED CHORD
presets.desc: A held fifth chopped into a rhythm: twelve hits a bar, the gate and accent lanes carving short and long ones, a few left to chance, stacked and spread.

presets.name: PULSE PAD
presets.desc: A pad that pulses: ninths arpeggiated up and down in sixteenths, two saws stacked and spread, soft attacks and tails that overlap into a moving chord.

presets.name: BREAK PAD
presets.desc: For the breakdown: slow quarter notes of a seventh chord melting together, stacked saws spread wide, the filter breathing over four bars.

presets.name: PULSE DRONE
presets.desc: A drone for the break: a low fifth held without a gap, the mixer pushed into the ladder filter, the level pulsing in eighths and the cutoff moving over four bars.
